claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spellcasting_focus
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive property grants a real casting capability while the item is held. The current passive effect atoms do not represent using an item as a spellcasting focus or constraining that focus to a class spell list.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding the hat, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_list_choice_with_normal_cast_time
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The activation does not grant one named spell. It lets the wielder choose any eligible Wizard-list spell they do not know, expend a matching spell slot, and then cast that chosen spell using its own printed casting time. Current grant_spell_access only names a fixed spellId, and ActivatedAbilityMechanics requires a fixed activationCost rather than inheriting the chosen spell's casting time.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list ... On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: conditional_cooldown_on_success
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The once-per-rest lockout is applied only after the Arcana check succeeds. Current activation resources and reset cadence model spending on activation, not a branch-conditioned post-success cooldown.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "On a successful check, you cast the spell ... and you can't use this property again until you finish a Short or Long Rest."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several failure-table results deterministically create mundane objects. v4 names create_object, but the current authored surface and tracer do not expose it as an EffectAtom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You pull a nonmagical object out of the hat."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: random_table_uncontrolled_catalog_spawn
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: One random-table branch creates a creature that is explicitly not under the user's control and expires later. Existing creature payloads are spell-scoped families centered on controlled companions or reanimation menus, not nonspell random-table side effects inside a magic-item activation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "A creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The creature isn't under your control and acts as it normally would, and it disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points."
